department: Research School of Finance, Actuarial Studies and Statistics

deadline.value: RSFAS's international scholarship date (31 August) for first-semester 2027 has passed, and all first-semester applications close 31 October 2026. For funding, the next central round is Round 2, closing 15 April 2027 (year inferred) for starts by 31 August 2027.
deadline.quote: The application deadline to be considered in Round 1 (commencement of study in following year) is 31 August. The application deadline to be considered in Round 2 (commencement of study in same year) is 15 April.

also.quote: While all applications for first semester entry must be submitted before 31 October, international applicants wishing to be considered for an ANU scholarship should submit their applications before 31 August.
Round 2 has a deadline of 15 April and is typically a smaller round with commencement or take up of the scholarship up to the end of August of the same year.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: You need not contact supervisors first; list one or two potential supervisors in the application, and the RSFAS HDR committee decides admission competitively.
supervisor.quote: While other ANU schools may recommend contacting potential supervisors before submitting an application, this is not required for entry into RSFAS’s PhD programs. | Potential supervisors cannot guarantee entry into the PhD program.

funding.value: Stipend scholarships are allocated competitively through ANU's central rounds. The RTP stipend is AUD 40,475 a year (2027 base rate).
funding.quote: HDR living stipend scholarships are allocated following a competitive process.

also.quote: $ 40,475 per annum (Full-time base RTP stipend rate 2027)

entry_route.value: A bachelor's with First Class or Second Class Honours Division A in statistics or a related field, or a master's with a substantial research thesis, or equivalent experience. Weaker research backgrounds may be pointed to the MPhil.
entry_route.quote: an Australian Bachelor degree (or equivalent) with First Class Honours or Second Class Honours Division A in statistics (or a related discipline), or | another qualification (e.g. a Master degree) with a substantial research thesis component

notes: PhD in Statistics (College of Business and Economics) includes a coursework component; shortlisted applicants may be interviewed.
